subject: Risk & Compliance
title: NFTs as Laundering Tools
description: Learn NFTs as Laundering Tools in one minute.

hook.text: Someone pays $69 million for a digital image. Is it art appreciation or money laundering?

buildup.text: NFTs can be bought and sold anonymously. Prices are subjective. That makes them ideal for wash trading.

discovery.text: The US Treasury flagged NFTs as a high-risk channel for money laundering in a 2022 study.

twist.text: You can buy your own NFT from yourself to create a fake transaction history and justify dirty money.

climax.text: NFTs combine the opacity of art markets with the speed of crypto. A perfect storm for laundering.

punchline.text: Buy your own NFT from yourself. Clean money. No questions.

quiz.question: Why are NFTs flagged as a money laundering risk?
options: Anonymous trading, subjective prices, and easy wash trading
They are always used for crime
NFT platforms have strict KYC rules
